question: Do functions with direct Ghidra references to frontend-root pointer global 0x82FFD624 contain a proved store to the root object's +0x08 word?

scope.stopCondition: Stop after all 60 direct-reference owners are checked or after a store is proved to use the pointer loaded from 0x82FFD624 as its base. Do not expand to functions without a direct recorded reference in this packet.
scope.boundary: The displacement scan covers decoded register-plus-0x08 writes inside these Ghidra-defined functions. It does not prove the absence of computed, indexed, indirect, constructor, or unlisted writes.

dependencies.use: Identifies the observed getter and frontend-root +0x08 source.

currentEvidence.method: One exact-reference query, seven bounded field-write batches, and one exact initialized-word query ran in the canonical version-1.3 Ghidra project, foreground and read-only. Three candidate function bodies were decompiled to compare each store base with the global-root read.

entries.result: The program image word is zero. This does not identify when or how a live root pointer is published.
Ghidra returned 67 READ references in 60 distinct containing functions.
Seven batches scanned 1886 decoded instructions in the 60 functions without truncation and found three syntactic stores.
A word store in 0x82D5F858 uses an object allocated in that function; its frontend-root read is at +0x5C, so this is not a proved root +0x08 write.
A byte store in 0x82DE6D58 uses the value decompiled as returned by thunk 0x827F7C88, not the visible frontend-root read at +0x54. The decompilation reports truncated control flow.
A word store in 0x82D8D430 uses the value decompiled as returned by thunk 0x827F7C88, while the visible frontend-root read is at +0x04.

locators: ghidra/FindFieldAccesses.java:+0x08 WRITE; seven exact function batches in scope.queryBatches
currentEvidence.qualification: No candidate was proved to store to frontend-root +0x08. Ghidra's thunk interpretation and truncated control flow limit the candidate-body inference. This is a direct-reference-owner census, not a program-wide writer search; no runtime mask value or bit transition was observed.

guards: Do not infer that frontend-root +0x08 has no writer from these three unproved candidate stores.
Do not assign gameplay meanings to the mask bits from this census.
Do not extend this direct-reference result to constructors, computed addresses, indirect references, or functions missing from Ghidra's listing.
conclusion: None of the 60 functions with a direct Ghidra reference to 0x82FFD624 contains a proved store to the root's +0x08 word under this bounded scan. The writer and bit meanings remain unresolved. A decisive next observation would identify the actual base object and value at one +0x08 store, either by a narrower constructor dataflow trace or an authorized runtime write watch on the resolved root pointer.
